scope: 4 roof ceramic albedo sources, metric tile UV graph and PBR maps

calls.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. New game PBR material albedo source, variant 1 of 4. Reference image is palette and material reference ONLY: yellow glazed Forbidden City roof tiles. Produce ONE flat continuous glazed ceramic material color swatch filling entire square 2048 x 2048 image, orthographic top-down, no objects, no tile divisions, no grout, no rim, no perspective, no text. Color: rich imperial golden yellow with subtle warm amber mottling. Authentic subtle fired ceramic mineral coloration, very fine hairline glaze crazing, tiny pits, fine grain. CLEAN BASE COLOR ONLY: no cast shadows, no directional lighting, no highlights, no specular reflections, no ambient-occlusion vignette. Completely uniform neutral illumination. No large repeating spots. Seamlessly repeatable on all edges. Tile structure and convex curves will be authored in the normal map separately; do not draw them into the albedo. Preserve rich yellow ceramic color, not metallic gold.
